verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both shrink the original into a 320x50 strip, and the side illustrations are cropped and jammed against the left and right edges, so the figures read as clutter rather than characters. In A the 'CREATIVE AGENCY' subtitle is slightly larger and easier to read; in B it is noticeably tinier at this size, though the CLAYTONI headline, colours and balance are kept in both.
